question: Why is ketamine hydrochloride short, and what do we do?

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 618 days before the posting

sentences.text: Ketamine hydrochloride is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; FDA's history shows an earlier shortage first posted on 2018-02-16, since resolved.
FDA inspection 976095 at Hospira, Inc. ended 2016-06-08 and was classified OAI, 618 days before the 2018-02-16 posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to Hospira, Inc. on 2017-02-14, 367 days before the posting.
FDA inspection 1031233 at Hospira, Inc. ended 2017-10-27 and was classified VAI, 112 days before the posting.
Corvale East holds 39 vials of the 50 mg/mL, 10 mL presentation at 7.2 vials per day, giving 5.4 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 126 vials of the same presentation at 7.7 vials per day, giving 16.4 days on hand.
The best option by rule is to transfer 18 vials of 50 mg/mL, 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would leave Corvale General with 14 days and bring Corvale East to 8 days.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
